title: Affine Bernstein assertion in dimensions three through nine
exact_target: For $3\leq n\leq 9$, let u be smooth on a nonempty open convex $\Omega \subset R^{n}$ with $D^{2}u$ positive definite and $\Sigma _ij$ $U^ij$ $\partial _ij(det$ $D^{2}u)^(-(n+1)/(n+2))=0$, $U=det(D^{2}u)(D^{2}u)^{-1}$. If the graph metric $\delta _ij+u_i$ $u_j$ is complete, must $\Omega =R^{n}$ and $u(x)=\tfrac12 x^{T}Ax+b\cdot x+c$ with A positive definite?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
